notes: Only the BOOTLOADER build calls lcd_run_seq(seq_init) (lcd_init_device()).

HAVE_LCD_SLEEP is #ifndef BOOTLOADER, so bootloader and firmware expansions of lcd_init_seq_23 differ: the firmware one is prefixed with 6x NOP+DELAY (release from deep standby), the bootloader one is not.
Types 2/3 seq_awake IS lcd_init_seq_23, so a firmware sleep/wake cycle replays a full init. Types 0/1 wake is only 0x11 + 0x29.
S5L_LCD_WITH_READID is not defined for ipod6g, so Rockbox never issues a read transaction; /RD is expected idle for an entire Rockbox boot.
